cites.quote: The Likud, Bayit Yehudi, Shas, and United Torah Judaism recommended Netanyahu – giving him 51 voices. The Zionist Union expectedly threw its support behind its leader, Herzog, who thus won 24 voices,and was joined by Meretz' five seats. The Joint Arab List has decided to not nominate any candidate for prime minister. ... Yesh Atid informed President Reuven Rivlin that it would not recommend any candidate as prime minister.
The score before the Meretz meeting is 24 nominations for Zionist Union leader Isaac Herzog, 67 for Netanyahu, and 24 MKs have decided not to nominate anyone.

שש רשימות, המייצגות 67 מנדטים, המליצו על הטלת תפקיד הרכבת הממשלה על בנימין נתניהו: הליכוד, כולנו, הבית היהודי, ש"ס, יהדות התורה וישראל ביתנו ... רשימות המחנה הציוני ומרצ המליצו על הטלת התפקיד על יצחק הרצוג

notes: Consultations were held on 22–23 March 2015; President Rivlin tasked Netanyahu on 25 March 2015. Updated on 5 November 2026: the Joint List and Yesh Atid are now quoted as making no recommendation (previously the unstated remainder).

events.textEn: Rivlin tasked Netanyahu with forming a government for 28 days.
events.textHe: ריבלין הטיל על נתניהו להרכיב ממשלה בתוך 28 ימים.

events.textEn: Rivlin granted Netanyahu a two-week extension.
events.textHe: ריבלין העניק לנתניהו הארכה של שבועיים.

cites.quote: Israeli President Reuven Rivlin granted Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s request for an additional two weeks in which to form a government.

events.textEn: Netanyahu notified Rivlin that he had formed a government.
events.textHe: נתניהו הודיע לריבלין כי עלה בידו להרכיב ממשלה.

cites.quote: I am honored to inform you that I have been successful in forming a government

cites.quote:
הצבעה מס' 917

בעד החוק – 62
נגד – 55
נמנעים – 2
חוק-יסוד: ישראל – מדינת הלאום של העם היהודי נתקבל.
It passed early Thursday morning after hours of contentious debate by a vote of 62-55, with two abstentions.

cites.quote: UTJ joined the coalition formed after the 2015 election with two deputy ministers (health and education)
In addition to the Likud, the coalition included the ultra-Orthodox and religious parties (United Torah Judaism, Shas, and the Jewish Home) and Kulanu

coalition.note: Two independent studies and the Israel Democracy Institute count United Torah Judaism in the coalition, which it joined under a signed agreement without a cabinet minister. Yakov Litzman’s deputy health post starts on 19 May 2015, not on the investiture day.
coalition.noteEn: United Torah Judaism does not take ministerial posts; Yakov Litzman became Deputy Health Minister on 19 May 2015.
coalition.noteHe: יהדות התורה אינה מקבלת תפקידי שרים; יעקב ליצמן מונה לסגן שר הבריאות ב־19 במאי 2015.

notes: Election-list seats at formation; the five rows of the Israel Democracy Institute table match the official results.
The European Parliamentary Research Service prose omits Shas from its coalition list; use the five-party Israel Democracy Institute table and the established first-government scheme for composition.
The government continued through the two elections in 2019; its replacement date is 17 May 2020, not the April 2019 election.
